title: Gluing compatible local submodules of an internal module
statement: Let X be a scheme, R any ring object in abelian pro-etale sheaves, Q an internal R-module [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and U a pro-etale cover [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. Let L_i be modules over R|Ui and q_i:L_i→Q|Ui monic. Assume the underlying pulled-back abelian sheaves L_i and L_j on every pairwise overlap are isomorphic by a map commuting with their injections into restricted Q, using upperStarCompIso. Then LocalSubmoduleGluingData [def-weil-pbc-proetale-local-submodule-gluing-data] is inhabited. Neither finiteness of the cover nor commutativity of R is required.

proof.text: Forget the local module monomorphisms to abelian sheaves and apply compatible local subsheaf gluing, retaining the inclusion, local isomorphisms, and local factorization property.

Factor the ambient action R⊗P→Q through P using the local actions transported along the local isomorphisms and the inverse-image tensor comparison. Cancel the monomorphism P→Q to prove the unit and associativity laws. The same cancellation proves local comparison maps linear.
Package the resulting module, inclusion and local module isomorphisms into LocalSubmoduleGluingData.

theorem exists_module_of_compatible_local_monomorphisms
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj R]
    (Q : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R)
    (U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (L : ∀ i, Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (U.X i)) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj R))
    (q : ∀ i, L i ⟶ ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod R).obj Q)
    (hq : ∀ i, Mono (q i))
    (hcompatible : ∀ i j, ∃ c :
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L i).X ≅
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L j).X,
      c.hom ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q j).hom =
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q i).hom ≫
          (upperStarCompIso Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.condition (f := U.f i) (g := U.f j))).hom.app
            Q.X) :
    Nonempty (LocalSubmoduleGluingData X R Q U L q)
